interpretations.statement: The time it takes a business to receive money changes.

limits.text: The amount owed is unchanged: what moves is when it arrives.

interpretations.rationale: The settlement window is what the announcement states, and the documented mechanism is what bounds it to timing.

interpretations.statement: A business on this rail can plan its cash timing against a shorter settlement window.
interpretations.rationale: The shorter settlement window is the only thing the material establishes about a business's own planning.

reader_connection.text: The configured audience is paid on terms it does not set, so when money arrives is a decision it actually takes.
